subject: Amend the NFI freeze for the IM-023 cells and score items 3-5
description: Tobias approved on 2026-11-06 an amendment to the 2026-10-27 NFI holdout freeze (not a change) so the IM-023 main (29 classes) and control (28) checkpoints can be scored against the same sealed holdout and truth v1, with the fraction head allowed for the primary 28->tall/gran rule and the pre-registered mixed-class test (item 5); plus LUCAS with 28 folded into pine or spruce by fraction share (item 4). Scope: an amendment manifest and protocol, the per-plot dump with hard class and fraction shares, the scorers and their tests, and the eval job manifests including the already-run item-1 job. The original freeze, its cells and its code pin stay untouched. Scoring the sealed holdout is approved for this evaluation. Review: Codex or Tobias.
